explanation: Compared against erdosproblems.com/957 (Erdős–Pach): for A ⊂ ℝ² of size n with distinct distances d_1 < … < d_k and f(d) the number of times d is determined, is f(d_1)f(d_k) ≤ (9/8 + o(1))n²? Solved affirmatively by Dumitrescu (≤ (9/8)n² + O(n)). The Lean statement: ∀ ε > 0, for all large n, every n-point A ⊂ ℝ² and every least/greatest element d₁, dₖ of its distance set satisfy distanceMultiplicity A d₁ · distanceMultiplicity A dₖ ≤ (9/8 + ε)n², where the multiplicity counts unordered pairs. The o(1) is uniform in A, as intended. Faithful.
